title: Tuvima file-name cleaning
description: What the Match tab's pre-fill, the Videos title cleaner and the scan read from a file or folder name (universal editor v5, D33): the noise words by family, the separators, the year rule, the season-and-episode patterns, the track and disc patterns and the edition markers. One file, so the editor and the scan behave alike. A key a person's file leaves out takes the value of the file shipped with the Engine; a person may add words of their own under custom_noise_words.

noise_words.description: Words that are release noise rather than part of a title, by family (resolution, source, codec, audio, release flags, container). A word matches whole, ignoring case; a hyphen inside a word may be left out of the name ("web-dl" matches "webdl").

custom_noise_words.description: Words a person adds of their own; they are treated like the shipped noise words.

ambiguous_words.description: Noise words that are also ordinary title words ("Magnum Opus"). They only count after " - " or an opening bracket.

noise_patterns.description: Regular expressions for noise a word list cannot spell, such as any resolution (\d{3,4}[pi]).

separators.description: Characters read as spaces in a release-style name (one with no spaces of its own).

year.description: How a year is recognised in a name.

season_episode_patterns.description: Regular expressions that read a season and an episode, with the named groups s (season) and e (episode).

season_folder_pattern.description: A regular expression for a folder that names a season ("Season 02", "Specials").

track_patterns.description: Regular expressions that read a track number and, where there is one, a disc number, with the named groups track and disc.

edition_markers.description: Words that name an edition of a title (Extended, Director's Cut, Remastered, Live). They count inside brackets or after the release noise starts.
